subject: CloudHaven discovery: competitive eval plan & qualification roadmap
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rebecca Li <rebecca@cloudhaven.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudHaven discovery: competitive eval plan & qualification roadmap

Hi Rebecca,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and very helpful signal on the two main evaluation tracks you care about: (1) raw model quality (hallucination, instruction-following, truthfulness) and (2) inference economics (latency/cost at scale). I wrote up a short recap + proposed roadmap so we can move to a scoped proof-of-concept quickly. Attaching discovery notes and a first-pass MAP.

Key takeaways (from our call):
- Primary use: in-product summarization + context-aware search for enterprise documents (sensitive PII).
- Baseline: CloudHaven currently routes to HyperscaleAPI for production. You're interested in: output fidelity at typical document lengths (1k-4k tokens), and 99th percentile latency at 8k-context workloads.
- Must-haves: SOC2 evidence (we flagged that), model-level redaction controls, and deterministic hallucination checks for compliance reviews.

Proposed next steps (timeline in MAP):
1) Shared artifacts (ASAP): CloudHaven sends a 50-doc sample (anonymized) + 10 representative prompts.
2) Evaluation run (week 1): Redwood runs side-by-side against Hyperscale and Hyperscale-quant variants using our eval prompt suite. We'll capture: exact-match facts, hallucination-rate, response length distribution, and cost/latency breakdown.
3) Regression & safety probes (week 1–2): targeted hallucination probes, prompt adversaries, and failure-mode tracing.
4) PoC plan (week 2–3): run 10k inference tokens/day for 3 days in a sandbox; mutually sign-off on success criteria.

Immediate asks for CloudHaven:
- Send the anonymized sample set + the 10 canonical prompts (procurement can include delivery constraints).
- Confirm which SLA/latency window matters more for go/no-go (99p latency vs cost-per-token).

Notes: We plan to include a deterministic hallucination checklist (examples attached) and an explicit prompt suite for regression testing.

Attachments: cloudhaven_discovery_notes.pdf, mutual_action_plan_DH-76391.xlsx

Thanks — I looped Marissa for the eval plan and Ben/Laura for procurement & solution pricing.

Best,

Subject: Re: CloudHaven discovery: competitive eval plan & qualification roadmap

Looping in the eval plan and the first-pass prompt suite. Rebecca — I attached eval_prompt_suite_v1.csv; it contains three groups: fidelity checks, hallucination probes (date/number/person/place extraction), and instruction-following edge cases. Short summary of the tests: 

Fidelity (automated metrics):
- Exact-match facts (precision/recall against ground truth table)
- Hallucination rate: percentage of responses that include unsupported facts
- Contradiction detection: embed-based consistency checks across multiple answers

Behavioral probes (manual / human-in-the-loop):
- Date drift suite (20 prompts): known dates present in the document, ask for chronological ordering and event attribution.
- Numeric stability (10 prompts): totals/percentages in financial-like doc snippets.
- Instruction-following (15 prompts): multi-step editing tasks that must preserve specific tokens.

Operational metrics to capture during runs:
- 50p/95p/99p token latency, latency by sequence-length buckets (0-1k, 1k-4k, 4k-8k)
- Token cost and cost-per-inferred-document
- KV-cache hit rates for repeated context queries

Proposed success criteria (PoC):
- Hallucination rate < 3% on the date/numeric probes
- 99p latency < 450ms for 1k–4k bucket OR a clear tradeoff plan (quantized variant with pre-warm)
- SOC2 doc exchange complete and acceptable

Next logistical asks:
- Rebecca: upload the 50-doc sample to the Drive link Sean shared and confirm redaction level (we can accept partially redacted docs).
- Procurement: please share any delivery constraints for the MAP (billing cadence / PO lead times).

Attachments: eval_prompt_suite_v1.csv

--
